title: Same name, different contents
hook: Identical filenames do not establish duplicate contents.

knows: reading short labels and comparing simple counts
doesNotKnow: Compare content identifiers instead of only names.

objective: Compare content identifiers instead of only names.

claims.text: Scenario, hook and prediction: Identical filenames do not establish duplicate contents. Which comparison distinguishes the two report files? Correct option: Content identifier. All fixture labels, example words, dates, task durations and file fields are stipulated exercise data.
claims.source: Explicit exercise fixture in src/lib/lifehacks/studyCatalog.ts and pure rules in studyModels.ts. All times, sizes, deadlines and outcomes describe this exercise only; no empirical productivity or learning effect is inferred.

claims.text: The two report files have different content identifiers. Names can collide; this fixture compares declared content, not a real cryptographic hash.
